questions.stem: Which best describes the difference between Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML)?
options: They are the same technology with different names
AI is a branch of ML
ML is a subset of AI that lets computers learn from data without explicit programming
ML is hardware while AI is software

questions.stem: Which pair names the two main types of Machine Learning?
In supervised machine learning, what is the main role of labelled data?
options: To find hidden patterns without categories
To train the algorithm with known inputs and their correct outputs
To group similar points into clusters

questions.stem: A data scientist's dataset has no predefined labels, and the algorithm must find hidden patterns and group similar points. This approach is:
How is Computer Vision related to AI?
options: It is completely separate from AI
It is a field of AI that extracts meaningful information from images and videos
It needs no data or algorithms

questions.stem: The technology that lets computers understand, interpret and respond to human language in spoken and written form is:
Which statement correctly distinguishes speech recognition from Natural Language Processing?
options: Speech recognition turns spoken words into text, while NLP understands and processes language
Speech recognition is part of computer vision

questions.stem: An AI medical assistant uses stored expert knowledge, rules and reasoning to analyze symptoms and suggest solutions. What type of AI system is this?
options: A storage system that only saves information
A system that replaces all human experts
An expert system that reasons with expert knowledge to solve complex problems

questions.stem: What is the first stage in developing an expert system?
options: Building a knowledge base by gathering information from experts
Asking users to fill a questionnaire

questions.stem: Which correctly distinguishes a chatbot from a virtual assistant?
options: A chatbot uses only text and a virtual assistant only voice
A chatbot answers website visitors' questions, while virtual assistants like Siri perform many tasks on devices
Chatbots are not based on AI

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of cloud computing?
options: To store data only on local computers
To deliver computing services such as servers, storage, databases and software over the Internet
To remove the need for the Internet

questions.stem: Which cloud model has resources owned, operated and maintained by a service provider and delivered over the Internet to many users?
Which statement correctly distinguishes a private cloud from a public cloud?
options: A private cloud belongs to a provider and a public cloud to one organization
A private cloud is dedicated to one organization with full control, while a public cloud serves many organizations over the Internet
A private cloud is cheaper in all cases
A private cloud needs no infrastructure

questions.stem: In AI in education, which of these is NOT a benefit?
options: Adapting to each student's learning needs

questions.stem: Which ethical issues are specifically associated with ChatGPT?
options: Cheating, plagiarism, misinformation, bias and data privacy

questions.stem: Which correctly identifies a limitation of AI algorithms?
options: They can produce wrong results, and how they reach decisions is often not transparent
They follow fixed formulas that guarantee correct results

questions.stem: What is a hybrid cloud?
options: A cloud that only stores data
A cloud owned equally by many organizations
A combination of public and private clouds that can share data and applications
A cloud that does not use the Internet

questions.stem: Which describes a possible negative impact of AI-based automation?
options: It creates unlimited jobs in every sector
It can cause job losses in areas such as manufacturing, business and healthcare
It has no effect on employment

questions.stem: A hospital's AI analyzes X-rays and MRI scans to spot early cancer after being trained on thousands of images already labelled by doctors. Which type of machine learning is this?
A bank's AI predicts loan defaulters from income, debt, credit history, age, gender and mobile number. Which data should be removed from the model to keep it fair and relevant?

options: X private, Y public, Z hybrid

questions.stem: A university worries that students use ChatGPT to write essays, harming learning and fair assessment. Which ethical issues are relevant?
options: Cheating, plagiarism and a negative impact on teaching and learning
